entry.name: jit.scope
entry.description: jit.scope lets you visually inspecting matrix values and display them as waveform, vectorscope, histogram or parade visual data.

attributes.name: accum
attributes.digest: Sets the amount of data, per pixel, to accumulate for display
attributes.description: Sets the amount of data, per pixel, to accumulate for display.

attributes.name: accum_desat
attributes.digest: Display desaturation for parade mode
attributes.description: When theobject is set to parade mode, this attribute sets the desaturation for the display (expressed as a float in the range 0. 1.0).
